Full summary: First session on the plugin 1.13.0 bundled server (2.0.0, sh -lc spawn) — verified read-write against the version-2 config, state intact. Updated settings.json allowlist to the new tool namespace mcp__plugin_twining_twining__*.
Decisions: Replaced mcp__twining__* with mcp__plugin_twining_twining__* in the settings allowlist rather than keeping both — the project .mcp.json server that owned the old namespace is deleted, and a stale allowlist entry would mask a misconfiguration if that namespace ever reappeared.
Findings: Restart verification passed: plugin:twining:twining is the sole twining server, spawned via the 1.13.0 sh -lc login shell in cmux, resolving twining-mcp@^2.0.0 to 2.0.0; version-2 config accepted read-write; counts carried over (383/257/499/1148). The predicted namespace shift (mcp__twining__* → mcp__plugin_twining_twining__*) did occur — plugin-bundled MCP tool prefixes include the plugin path.
